label: Netlify
description: Netlify personal access tokens for the API and the CLI.

signals.reason: A personal access token (nfp_) acts on every site of the account. A deploy can be rolled back. A deleted site cannot.
The variable name is the Netlify CLI token variable. The token acts on every site of the account.
The item name or a label names Netlify.
A host of the item is a Netlify host.
